name: text-attention-bounce
title: Attention Bounce
description: Cả từ nhảy hai nhịp (cao 30 % rồi 12 %), bẹp nhẹ khi chạm đất, rồi nghỉ 2 giây trước khi nhảy lại.

moworks.author: moworks

credit.author: Moworks Studio
credit.madeNote: the studio's own motion, written here

moworks.notes: Whole word, pivot bottom centre. Jump 1: y 0 → −30 % of its height in 0.24 s ease-out, back to 0 in 0.2 s ease-in, squash scale (1.06, 0.9) for 0.1 s on landing; jump 2: −12 % in 0.16 s, down in 0.12 s, squash (1.04, 0.94) for 0.08 s; 0.8 s in all, then 2 s rest (loop 2.8 s, CSS keys at 8.6 / 15.7 / 21.4 / 25.7 / 28.6 %). Demo adds a small take-off squash (0.95) and a floor shadow ellipse that shrinks while airborne. Params: heights: độ cao hai nhịp (30 % / 12 %) · duration (0.8 s) · squash (0.9) · rest: nghỉ giữa các lần (2 s).
moworks.titleVi: Từ nhảy hai nhịp gây chú ý
